description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaleliya, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510278 (23/0277)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific declarations of land title determinations for particular parcels of land (No. 0255 and No. 0116), including details about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content focuses on property rights and land administration rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
